name: @fioenix/huly-mcp

tools.name: huly_context
tools.description: Report how this server is configured — version, host origin, workspace, masked token with the account and workspace it is bound to, actor, proxy — and any problem detectable without reaching Huly. Use this first when a call fails to connect or writes land under the wrong name. Never returns the token itself.

tools.name: huly_whoami
tools.description: Verify the connection to Huly and return the authenticated account info.

tools.name: huly_list_projects
tools.description: List all projects in the Huly workspace.

limit.description: Max projects to return (default 50; 0 means no cap)

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to keep, or "all" for whole documents. Default: _id,identifier,name,description,private,archived

tools.name: huly_list_users
tools.description: List people in the workspace. Use a returned `_id` as the `assignee` argument of huly_create_task / huly_update_task.

activeOnly.description: Only workspace members that are active (default false — returns everyone)

limit.description: Max people to return (default 50; 0 means no cap)

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to keep, or "all" for whole documents. Default: _id,name,active,role

tools.name: huly_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with optional filters. By default completed tasks are excluded unless a status filter is given. Pass `parentId` to fetch only direct children of a parent task.

overdue.description: Only tasks past their due date

parentId.description: Parent task identifier (e.g. LAMBD-568) or internal _id — returns direct children only

limit.description: Max tasks to return (default 50; 0 means no cap)

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to keep, or "all" for whole documents. Default: _id,identifier,title,status,statusName,priority,assignee,dueDate,projectName,milestone,component,subIssues,modifiedOn

tools.name: huly_get_task
tools.description: Get full details for a single task by its identifier (e.g. DELTA-123), including the description as markdown.

tools.name: huly_create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in a project. Pass `parentId` to create it as a sub-issue of an existing task.

parentId.description: Parent task identifier (e.g. OMEGA-588) or internal _id — creates this task as its sub-issue. Must be in the same project.

kindId.description: Task type _id from huly_list_task_kinds. Defaults to the standard Issue type.

tools.name: huly_update_task
tools.description: Update a task by identifier. Only the provided fields are changed.

descriptionMarkdown.description: Replace the description with this markdown

comment.description: Add a comment to the task

tools.name: huly_delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task. This cannot be undone — set confirm=true to proceed.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete

tools.name: huly_report
tools.description: Generate a daily or weekly task report: tasks due in the window plus overdue tasks.

tools.name: huly_list_labels
tools.description: List all labels/tags in the workspace.

limit.description: Max labels to return (default 50; 0 means no cap)

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to keep, or "all" for whole documents. Default: _id,title,color,category,refCount

tools.name: huly_create_label
tools.description: Create a new label/tag.

tools.name: huly_assign_label
tools.description: Assign an existing label to a task.

title.description: Display title for the label reference

tools.name: huly_show_labels
tools.description: Show the labels assigned to a task.

tools.name: huly_list_teamspaces
tools.description: List all document teamspaces.

limit.description: Max teamspaces to return (default 50; 0 means no cap)

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to keep, or "all" for whole documents. Default: _id,name,description,private,archived

tools.name: huly_list_documents
tools.description: List documents within a teamspace.

limit.description: Max documents to return (default 50; 0 means no cap)

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to keep, or "all" for whole documents. Default: _id,title,space,modifiedOn

tools.name: huly_read_document
tools.description: Read a document's content as markdown. Title match is case-insensitive and partial.

tools.name: huly_create_document
tools.description: Create a new document in a teamspace.

tools.name: huly_create_teamspace
tools.description: Create a new document teamspace.

tools.name: huly_list_task_kinds
tools.description: List the task types (kinds) available in a project — e.g. Task, Bug, EPIC, KPI. Use a returned `_id` as the `kindId` argument of huly_create_task / huly_update_task.

tools.name: huly_list_milestones
tools.description: List milestones in a project.

limit.description: Max milestones to return (default 50; 0 means no cap)

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to keep, or "all" for whole documents. Default: _id,label,status,targetDate

tools.name: huly_create_milestone
tools.description: Create a milestone in a project. Defaults the target date to two weeks out.

tools.name: huly_list_sub_issues
tools.description: Recursively list all sub-issues of a parent task by identifier. Returns a tree by default; set flat=true for a flat list. Solves the "huly_list_tasks only returns top-level" pain.

flat.description: Return a flat list instead of a tree (default false)

tools.name: huly_get_task_by_id
tools.description: Look up a task by its internal _id (the kind of id stored in childInfo[].childId), not by human identifier like LAMBD-568.

tools.name: huly_get_activity
tools.description: Return the activity timeline of an issue: DocUpdateMessage events (status/assignee/label changes with from→to) plus ChatMessage comments. Sorted newest first.

tools.name: huly_get_comments
tools.description: List comments attached to any Huly object (issue, milestone, document, component, project) by its internal _id. Unlike huly_get_activity (issue-only), this works for milestones and other classes. Returns comment body (markdown), author and timestamps, newest first; thread replies are nested under their parent comment in `replies`.

targetId.description: Internal _id of the parent object. For milestones use huly_list_milestones to get _id; the _id is also the path segment before "|" in a chunter link.

targetClass.description: Optional parent class filter: friendly alias (issue|milestone|component|project|document) or raw ref like "tracker:class:Milestone". Omit to match any class on that _id.

tools.name: huly_get_comment
tools.description: Resolve one ChatMessage comment by its _id — e.g. the "message" query param of a Huly chunter deep-link. Returns the comment body (markdown), author, timestamps, and any thread replies nested in `replies`.

messageId.description: ChatMessage _id, e.g. the value of the "message" query param in a chunter link

tools.name: huly_update_comment
tools.description: Replace the body of an existing comment, addressed by its _id (from huly_get_comments or the "message" query param of a chunter link). Works on thread replies too. Returns the comment as stored after the edit. Huly attributes the edit to the token owner, not to HULY_ACTOR.

messageId.description: ChatMessage _id of the comment to edit

tools.name: huly_delete_comment
tools.description: Permanently delete a comment by its _id. This cannot be undone — set confirm=true to proceed. Deleting a comment that has thread replies leaves those replies without a parent.

messageId.description: ChatMessage _id of the comment to delete

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete

tools.name: huly_milestone_report
tools.description: List every issue in a milestone, group by Epic, walk sub-issues recursively. Output is shaped for KPI checkin and pitstop reviews.

tools.name: huly_complete_milestone
tools.description: Mark a milestone as completed.

instructions: Tools manage tasks, projects, labels, documents, and milestones in a Huly workspace. Every tool returns a JSON envelope: { "status": "ok", ... } on success or { "status": "error", "error": "..." } on failure. Identifiers like DELTA-123 are task identifiers; projects, assignees, and statuses can be referenced by name or id. huly_delete_task is irreversible and requires confirm=true.
